skills.name: Wildfire Spreading
skills.description: Passive: Zaojun collects 20% of Energy consumed by friendly units and stores it as Incense Smoke, storing up to 1200 Incense Smoke. Active: Deals DMG equal to 400% ATK to 3 nearby targets and surrounding units. For every 300 Incense Smoke stored, consumes that amount to hit one additional unit. Target selection: selects from farthest to nearest, prioritizing heroes over summons. If the number of targets is less than the amount of Incense Smoke available, targets are reselected.

upgrades.level2: Hits one additional unit for every 240 Incense Smoke.
upgrades.level3: Hits one additional unit for every 200 Incense Smoke.
upgrades.level4: Hits one additional unit for every 150 Incense Smoke.

skills.name: Food Offering
skills.description: Throws food to restore HP equal to 200% ATK to the frontmost friendly unit. The projectile then ricochets to hit enemy units, dealing DMG equal to 50% ATK + 20% max HP to front-row enemies.

upgrades.level2: Ricocheting projectile deals DMG equal to 80% ATK + 20% max HP to front-row enemies.
upgrades.level3: Ricocheting projectile deals DMG equal to 80% ATK + 25% max HP to front-row enemies.
upgrades.level4: Ricocheting projectile deals DMG equal to 100% ATK + 30% max HP to front-row enemies.

skills.name: Hearth Fire Rising
skills.description: Passive: Zaojun no longer performs basic attacks. Instead, every 3s restores 80 Energy to herself and gains up to 10 stacks of 10% ATK.

upgrades.level2: Gains up to 10 stacks of 15% ATK.
upgrades.level4: Gains up to 10 stacks of 20% ATK.

skills.name: Fire Bond Shelter
skills.description: Upon entering battle, establishes a [Fire Bond] with the friendly unit with the highest HP on the field. Fire Bond: The bonded ally receives 15% DMG reduction. Zaojun continuously sacrifices her own HP to ensure the bonded ally's HP never drops below Zaojun's own HP.

relic.name: Blessed Fire Grace
relic.description: [Fire Bond] allies have 30% of their Energy consumption stored by Zaojun.

upgrades.level2: 15% of DMG dealt by Zaojun heals [Fire Bond] allies.
upgrades.level3: 25% of DMG dealt by Zaojun heals [Fire Bond] allies.
upgrades.level4: [Fire Bond] allies have 80% of their Energy consumption stored by Zaojun.
